import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)

    # --------------------------
    # 0. Only orders that already existed before seed_time
    # --------------------------
    orders = db["orders"]
    valid_orders = orders.loc[
        orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time, "order_id"
    ]
    valid_orders_set = set(valid_orders)

    filtered_order_items = db["order_items"][
        db["order_items"]["order_id"].isin(valid_orders_set) &
        (db["order_items"]["ts"] < seed_time)
    ].copy()

    # --------------------------
    # 1. Sales aggregations
    # --------------------------
    sales_agg = filtered_order_items.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_items=("order_item_id", "count"),
        total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        unique_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
        first_sale_ts=("ts", "min"),
        last_sale_ts=("ts", "max")
    ).reset_index()

    sales_agg["days_since_first_sale"] = (seed_time - sales_agg["first_sale_ts"]).dt.days
    sales_agg["days_since_last_sale"] = (seed_time - sales_agg["last_sale_ts"]).dt.days
    sales_agg = sales_agg.drop(columns=["first_sale_ts", "last_sale_ts"])

    for col_name, days in [("orders_30d", 30), ("orders_60d", 60), ("orders_90d", 90)]:
        cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=days)
        window_sales = filtered_order_items[
            filtered_order_items["ts"] >= cutoff
        ].groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique().rename(col_name)
        sales_agg = sales_agg.merge(window_sales, on="product_id", how="left")
        sales_agg[col_name] = sales_agg[col_name].fillna(0)

    # Previous year same-window comparison (if horizon allows)
    prev_cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)
    prev_sales = filtered_order_items[
        (filtered_order_items["ts"] >= prev_cutoff) &
        (filtered_order_items["ts"] < seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90))
    ].groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique().rename("orders_prev_90d")
    sales_agg = sales_agg.merge(prev_sales, on="product_id", how="left")
    sales_agg["orders_prev_90d"] = sales_agg["orders_prev_90d"].fillna(0)
    sales_agg["trend_90d"] = (sales_agg["orders_90d"] - sales_agg["orders_prev_90d"]) / (sales_agg["orders_prev_90d"] + 1e-9)

    sales_agg["ratio_30_to_90"] = sales_agg["orders_30d"] / (sales_agg["orders_90d"] + 1e-9)
    sales_agg["ratio_60_to_90"] = sales_agg["orders_60d"] / (sales_agg["orders_90d"] + 1e-9)

    # --------------------------
    # 2. Review features (only reviews already written before seed_time)
    # --------------------------
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    known_reviews = reviews[
        reviews["order_id"].isin(valid_orders_set) &
        (reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time)
    ][["order_id", "review_id", "review_score"]].copy()

    review_product = known_reviews.merge(
        filtered_order_items[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates(),
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    review_agg = review_product.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_reviews=("review_id", "nunique"),
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        std_review_score=("review_score", "std"),
        min_review_score=("review_score", "min"),
        bad_review_rate=("review_score", lambda x: (x <= 2).mean())
    ).reset_index()

    # --------------------------
    # 3. Payment features (only payments recorded before seed_time)
    # --------------------------
    payments = db["payments"]
    if "ts" in payments.columns:
        known_payments = payments[
            payments["order_id"].isin(valid_orders_set) &
            (payments["ts"] < seed_time)
        ].copy()
    else:
        known_payments = payments[payments["order_id"].isin(valid_orders_set)].copy()

    payment_product = known_payments.merge(
        filtered_order_items[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates(),
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    payment_agg = payment_product.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_payments=("payment_sequential", "count"),
        avg_payment_value=("payment_value", "mean"),
        avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        credit_card_share=("payment_type", lambda x: (x == "credit_card").mean())
    ).reset_index()

    # --------------------------
    # 4. Delivery / order-status features
    # Only use delivery dates that are already known (< seed_time)
    # --------------------------
    filtered_orders = orders[orders["order_id"].isin(valid_orders_set)].copy()
    order_product = filtered_orders.merge(
        filtered_order_items[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates(),
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )

    for col in ["order_approved_at", "order_delivered_carrier_date",
                "order_delivered_customer_date", "order_estimated_delivery_date"]:
        order_product.loc[order_product[col] >= seed_time, col] = pd.NaT

    order_product["purchase_to_approval_days"] = (
        order_product["order_approved_at"] - order_product["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ).dt.days
    order_product["purchase_to_carrier_days"] = (
        order_product["order_delivered_carrier_date"] - order_product["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ).dt.days
    order_product["purchase_to_customer_days"] = (
        order_product["order_delivered_customer_date"] - order_product["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ).dt.days
    order_product["estimated_vs_actual_days"] = (
        order_product["order_estimated_delivery_date"] - order_product["order_delivered_customer_date"]
    ).dt.days

    status_agg = order_product.groupby(["product_id", "order_status"]).agg(
        status_count=("order_id", "nunique")
    ).reset_index()
    status_pivot = status_agg.pivot(
        index="product_id", columns="order_status", values="status_count"
    ).reset_index().fillna(0)
    status_pivot.columns = [
        f"order_status_{col}" if col != "product_id" else col
        for col in status_pivot.columns
    ]

    delivery_agg = order_product.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_purchase_to_approval_days=("purchase_to_approval_days", "mean"),
        avg_purchase_to_carrier_days=("purchase_to_carrier_days", "mean"),
        avg_purchase_to_customer_days=("purchase_to_customer_days", "mean"),
        avg_estimated_vs_actual_days=("estimated_vs_actual_days", "mean"),
        on_time_delivery_rate=("estimated_vs_actual_days", lambda x: (x.dropna() >= 0).mean() if x.notna().any() else np.nan),
        delivered_orders=("order_delivered_customer_date", lambda x: x.notna().sum()),
        in_flight_orders=("order_id", "nunique")
    ).reset_index()
    delivery_agg["in_flight_share"] = 1 - delivery_agg["delivered_orders"] / (delivery_agg["in_flight_orders"] + 1e-9)
    delivery_agg = delivery_agg.drop(columns=["delivered_orders", "in_flight_orders"])

    # --------------------------
    # 5. Merge everything
    # --------------------------
    result = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": entity_ids}).set_index("product_id")
    for agg_df in [sales_agg, review_agg, payment_agg, delivery_agg, status_pivot]:
        result = result.join(agg_df.set_index("product_id"), how="left")

    # --------------------------
    # 6. Imputation + synthetic features
    # --------------------------
    count_cols = [
        "total_orders", "total_items", "total_revenue", "total_freight",
        "unique_sellers", "orders_30d", "orders_60d", "orders_90d",
        "orders_prev_90d", "total_reviews", "total_payments"
    ]
    status_cols = [c for c in result.columns if c.startswith("order_status_")]
    count_cols.extend(status_cols)
    result[count_cols] = result[count_cols].fillna(0)

    avg_cols = [
        "avg_price", "std_price", "avg_freight", "avg_review_score",
        "std_review_score", "min_review_score", "bad_review_rate",
        "avg_payment_value", "avg_installments", "credit_card_share",
        "avg_purchase_to_approval_days", "avg_purchase_to_carrier_days",
        "avg_purchase_to_customer_days", "avg_estimated_vs_actual_days",
        "on_time_delivery_rate", "in_flight_share",
        "ratio_30_to_90", "ratio_60_to_90", "trend_90d"
    ]
    for c in avg_cols:
        if c in result.columns:
            result[c] = result[c].fillna(0)

    max_recency_days = (seed_time - pd.Timestamp("2016-09-01")).days
    result[["days_since_first_sale", "days_since_last_sale"]] = result[
        ["days_since_first_sale", "days_since_last_sale"]
    ].fillna(max_recency_days)

    result["has_sales_history"] = (result["total_orders"] > 0).astype(int)
    result["recency_score"] = 1 / (result["days_since_last_sale"] + 1)
    result["frequency_score"] = (result["total_orders"] / (result["days_since_first_sale"] + 1)) * 30
    result["monetary_score"] = result["total_revenue"] / (result["total_orders"] + 1)

    # Final numeric-only guarantee
    result = result.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors="coerce").fillna(0)
    result = result.reindex(entity_ids)
    return result
